name: date_slash_basic
spec: "MM/DD/YYYY" or "M/D/YYYY" (slashes, 4-digit year): result is zero-padded MM/DD/YYYY.

name: date_slash_single_digits_padded
spec: "MM/DD/YYYY" or "M/D/YYYY" (slashes, 4-digit year): result is zero-padded MM/DD/YYYY.

name: date_day_first_refused
spec: When the first number is greater than 12 it is a day-first date → refused (null + reason), never swapped.

name: date_iso_basic
spec: "YYYY-MM-DD" (ISO, 1- or 2-digit month/day allowed): converted to MM/DD/YYYY.

name: date_iso_single_digit_parts
spec: "YYYY-MM-DD" (ISO, 1- or 2-digit month/day allowed): converted to MM/DD/YYYY.

name: date_month_name_with_comma
spec: "<Month> <day>, <year>" or "<Month> <day> <year>" (comma optional ...) ... converted.

name: date_month_name_no_comma_lowercase
spec: "<Month> <day>, <year>" or "<Month> <day> <year>" (comma optional ...) ... Month = full English name ... any letter case.

name: date_month_name_ordinal_suffix
spec: ... ordinal suffix st/nd/rd/th allowed on the day ... converted.

name: date_day_month_year
spec: "<day> <Month> <year>" / "<day> <Month>, <year>": converted.

name: date_sept_abbreviation_with_dot
spec: Month = full English name, 3-letter abbreviation (optionally with a dot) or "Sept", any letter case.

name: date_month_year_kept_as_written
spec: "<Month> <year>" (no day, e.g. "December 2027"): kept exactly as written (after space normalisation), not refused.

name: date_surrounding_and_repeated_spaces
spec: Surrounding and repeated spaces are ignored.

name: date_nonexistent_feb_30_refused
spec: A date that does not exist (02/30/2027, 13th month in ISO form, day 0, "Smarch 3, 2027") → refused.

name: date_iso_month_13_refused
spec: A date that does not exist (02/30/2027, 13th month in ISO form, day 0, "Smarch 3, 2027") → refused.

name: date_season_refused
spec: Anything else → refused: seasons ("Summer 2027"), ...

name: multi_list_basic
spec: Returns ["A | B", null] (parts joined with " | ", in the order given, duplicates removed keeping the first).

name: multi_pipe_string
spec: A string containing "|" is split on "|".

name: multi_duplicates_removed
spec: parts joined with " | ", in the order given, duplicates removed keeping the first.

name: multi_space_normalisation
spec: Each part is trimmed and inner runs of spaces collapse to one space; options are compared after the same normalisation.

name: multi_comma_fallback_split
spec: When the string has no "|" and is not itself an option, but contains commas and EVERY comma-separated part is an option, it is read as that list.

name: multi_option_containing_comma_whole
spec: An option that itself contains a comma, given whole, stays one part.

name: multi_empty_parts_dropped
spec: Empty parts are dropped.

name: multi_all_parts_empty_refused
spec: Empty parts are dropped; nothing left → refused.

name: multi_empty_string_refused
spec: Empty parts are dropped; nothing left → refused.

name: multi_missing_option_refused
spec: When options is a non-empty list, every part must be one of them, else refused (the reason names the missing part).

name: multi_case_sensitive_refused
spec: options are compared after the same normalisation (case-sensitive).

name: multi_comma_part_not_option_refused
spec: When the string has no "|" and is not itself an option, but contains commas and EVERY comma-separated part is an option, it is read as that list.

name: multi_list_invalid_element_refused
spec: When options is a non-empty list, every part must be one of them, else refused (the reason names the missing part).

name: multi_order_preserved
spec: Returns ["A | B", null] (parts joined with " | ", in the order given ...).

name: multi_empty_options_accepts_any
spec: When options is empty or missing, any non-empty parts are accepted.
